us_name: [レイアウト] 動画詳細 Overlay化（json2html）
module: 動画詳細 Overlay / Movie detail via Overlay + json2html (/{lang}/library/video/{id}) – DSR-587 (from DSR-173; related DSR-553/523/584, bug DSR-647 from DSR-501), baseline BL-OVL-1

tcs.feature: Publish CF related (live) → movie detail page created, movie plays (BAC#1, TCC#1)
tcs.summary: EN: Verify publishing CF related /content/dam/dsr/{lang}/movies/standard/qa587-main creates /{lang}/library/video/qa587-main and the movie plays. JP: CF related公開で動画詳細ページが生成され、動画が再生できることを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-587-01 (CF commune + CF related qa587-main, live). JP: TD-587-01 公開済み。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open https://<DEV>/en/library/video/qa587-main. 2. Record status, final URL, movie title. 3. Click play; wait 5 s; record player state (YouTube iframe src contains movieSourceId / video currentTime > 0). JP: 開く→記録→再生。
tcs.expected: EN: HTTP 200, no redirect; title = 'QA587 main movie'; player starts (iframe src contains the TD movieSourceId, or currentTime > 0 for DAM video). JP: 200、タイトル一致、再生開始。
tcs.design: BAC#1; TCC#1; BL-OVL-1 Editor action 'Publish CF related (live)'; DSR-MOVIE-012/014

tcs.summary: EN: Verify a CF related published to preview only exists on .aem.page and not on .aem.live. JP: プレビュー公開のみは .aem.page のみに生成されることを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-587-02 preview only. JP: TD-587-02。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open /en/library/video/qa587-preview on .aem.page and .aem.live. 2. Record statuses. JP: 両環境のステータス記録。
tcs.expected: EN: .aem.page 200 with the overlay not-found stub (rows source: overlay + unavailable: not-found, robots noindex, no movie title); .aem.live 404. By design: overlay reads published content only – Preview does not work with the overlay feature (Martin 23/10, DSR-674 Dismissed). JP: page=200（not-found スタブ・noindex）、live=404。仕様：オーバーレイはプレビュー非対応。

tcs.feature: Static HTML head + body without JS; no GraphQL in browser
tcs.summary: EN: Verify raw HTML contains title/description/og:image and movie title, and the browser makes no GraphQL request. JP: 生HTMLに head情報と動画タイトルがあり、ブラウザがGraphQLを呼ばないことを確認する。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. HTTP GET page (no JS); read <title>, meta description, og:image, body text. 2. Open in browser with network recording; filter 'graphql' / 'execute.json'. JP: 生HTML確認、ネットワーク確認。
tcs.expected: EN: <title> = 'QA587 main movie | YKK DIGITAL SHOWROOM'; meta description = TD description without line breaks; og:image absolute URL (200); body contains movie title; 0 GraphQL requests. JP: DSR-MOVIE-027〜029 と同じ値、GraphQL 0件。

tcs.summary: EN: Verify a CF related named with uppercase or '_' (QA587_Upper) does not produce a page. JP: 大文字・_ を含むCF名ではページが生成されないことを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-587-04 'QA587_Upper' published live. JP: TD-587-04。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open /en/library/video/QA587_Upper and /en/library/video/qa587_upper. 2. Record statuses. JP: ステータス記録。

tcs.summary: EN: Verify CF related in a subfolder of movies/standard/ and CF under /content/dam/ykk/… do not produce pages. JP: サブフォルダ・/content/dam/ykk 配下ではページが生成されないことを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-587-05 qa587-sub in /movies/standard/qa587/; existing qa501-main-a under /content/dam/ykk/common/product-cf/test/. JP: TD-587-05、qa501既存。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open /en/library/video/qa587-sub. 2. Open /en/library/video/qa501-main-a. 3. Record statuses. JP: ステータス記録。
tcs.design: BL-OVL-1 Path rules; QA observation (qa501-* will not generate pages)

tcs.feature: CF commune alone never creates a page (negative)
tcs.summary: EN: Verify a published CF commune (/content/dam/common/en/movies/qa587-commune-only) without CF related gives no page. JP: CF commune のみではページが生成されないことを確認する。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open /en/library/video/qa587-commune-only on .aem.page and .aem.live. JP: 両環境で開く。
tcs.expected: EN: 404 on both. JP: 両方404。

tcs.feature: isActive = false → noindex + redirect to movie list (BAC#4)
tcs.summary: EN: Verify isActive = false (republished) keeps the page with noindex and sends visitors to the movie list. JP: isActive=false で noindex、動画一覧へ遷移することを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-587-07 isActive OFF, republished live. JP: TD-587-07。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. HTTP GET raw; read meta robots. 2. Open in browser; wait 3 s; record final URL. JP: robots確認、最終URL記録。
tcs.expected: EN: meta robots contains 'noindex'; final URL = /en/library/video/search (movie list); movie title not shown. JP: noindex、/library/video/search へ遷移。

tcs.summary: EN: Verify unpublishing the CF commune then republishing the CF related shows the unavailable state (noindex, redirect as 7.0). JP: CF commune 非公開＋再公開で unavailable になることを確認する。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. HTTP GET raw: robots + 'unavailable' row. 2. Browser: final URL. JP: 確認。
tcs.expected: EN: noindex; single 'unavailable' row, no movie title in body; browser ends on movie list. JP: noindex、unavailable、一覧へ。

tcs.feature: CF commune edit takes effect only after CF related republish
tcs.summary: EN: Verify an edited + published CF commune changes the page only after the CF related is republished. JP: CF related 再公開で初めて反映されることを確認する。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Record title. 2. Author: movieTitle → 'QA587 main movie v2', publish CF commune. 3. Wait 5 min, reload, record. 4. Republish CF related. 5. Wait 5 min, reload, record. JP: 手順どおり。
tcs.expected: EN: Step 3 old title; step 5 'QA587 main movie v2'. JP: 3=旧、5=新。

tcs.summary: EN: Verify unpublishing CF related removes the page (preview + live) and from query-index. JP: CF related 非公開でページ・indexから削除されることを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-587-10 published live then unpublished. JP: TD-587-10。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open /en/library/video/qa587-removed on both hosts. 2. Search query-index. JP: 確認。
tcs.expected: EN: 404 on both; absent from query-index. JP: 404、indexなし。

tcs.feature: List pages keep working – no URL collision (BAC#3, TCC#3)
tcs.summary: EN: Verify /{lang}/library/video/search and /{lang}/library/video/tech-talk (Sites list pages) still render as list pages, not overlay. JP: 動画一覧・テックトーク一覧が従来どおり表示されることを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: List pages published (Martin test URL /en/library/video/search). JP: 一覧ページ公開済み。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open /ja|en|cn/library/video/search and /…/video/tech-talk. 2. Record status, presence of list block, absence of video-detail block. JP: 3言語で確認。
tcs.expected: EN: 200; list block present with ≥ 1 card; no video-detail / 'unavailable' row. JP: 200、一覧表示、詳細ブロックなし。
tcs.blocked: cn path not on DEV (Issue #18) – owner dev

tcs.summary: EN: Verify a movie CF related registered under the tech-talk subfolder is served at /{lang}/library/video/tech-talk/<id>. JP: テックトーク動画が /video/tech-talk/<id> で表示されることを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-587-12 in tech-talk folder (path per Q32). JP: TD-587-12。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open /en/library/video/tech-talk/qa587-tt. 2. Open /en/library/video/qa587-tt. 3. Record statuses. JP: 2URL確認。
tcs.expected: EN: tech-talk URL 200 with movie title; standard URL 404 (no duplicate). JP: tech-talk側のみ200。
tcs.blocked: Tech-talk path/regex not in BL-OVL-1 (Q32) – owner Martin

tcs.feature: Movie list filters query-index by path (TCC#4, DSR-523)
tcs.summary: EN: Verify the movie list shows standard movies only (no tech-talk, no list pages themselves). JP: 動画一覧が標準動画のみを表示することを確認する。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open /en/library/video/search. 2. Collect card hrefs. JP: hrefを収集。
tcs.expected: EN: qa587-main present; no href to /video/tech-talk/*, /video/search, /video/tech-talk. JP: 標準のみ。
tcs.blocked: Q32; DSR-523 change TBC – owner Martin

tcs.summary: EN: Verify at most 5 related movies are shown when 6 are linked. JP: 関連動画は最大5件表示されることを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-587-14 qa587-rel-a relatedMovies = 6 published movies. JP: TD-587-14。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open /en/library/video/qa587-rel-a. 2. Count movie cards in 関連コンテンツ. JP: 動画カード数。

tcs.feature: Related movie with isUnavailable = true hidden (DSR-501 P2 / DSR-647)
tcs.summary: EN: Verify a related movie whose CF commune has isUnavailable = true is not shown. JP: isUnavailable=true の関連動画が表示されないことを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-587-15 qa587-rel-b relatedMovies = rel-1, rel-off (isUnavailable TRUE). JP: TD-587-15。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open /en/library/video/qa587-rel-b. 2. List related movie titles. JP: タイトル一覧。
tcs.expected: EN: rel-1 shown; rel-off absent. JP: rel-offなし。

tcs.feature: Related contents order = update date desc
tcs.summary: EN: Verify 関連コンテンツ mixes movies, articles and LPs sorted by update date, newest first. JP: 関連コンテンツが更新日の新しい順に並ぶことを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-587-14 with related items of known update dates. JP: TD-587-14。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open /en/library/video/qa587-rel-a. 2. Read card order and each item's update date (card or target page meta). JP: 並びと更新日。
tcs.expected: EN: Order strictly by update date desc across types. JP: 更新日降順。
tcs.design: BL-OVL-1 Update (Martin DSR-647 comment 61175); DSR-MOVIE-021 (conflicts with DSR-647 'authored order' – A4)

tcs.feature: Regression DSR-173 Group A on overlay page
tcs.summary: EN: Verify DSR-173 Group A checks (DSR-MOVIE-012, 014, 020, 025, 026, 027–029, 033, 034) pass on the overlay page. JP: DSR-173 グループAがOverlayページで合格することを確認する。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Run tests/movie-detail/DSR-173.movie-detail.spec.ts with the page URL switched to /en/library/video/qa587-main (and qa587-rel-a for related checks). JP: URL切替でDSR-173スペック実行。
tcs.expected: EN: All listed DSR-MOVIE TCs pass; failures listed with TC ID. JP: 全合格。

tcs.summary: EN: Verify the same id renders per language with html lang matching and language CF commune text. JP: 言語ごとに表示されることを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-587-01 in ja, en, cn. JP: 3言語。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open /ja|en|cn/library/video/qa587-main. 2. Record status, html lang, title. JP: 記録。
tcs.expected: EN: 200; html lang = ja / en / zh; title = language value. JP: 言語一致。
tcs.blocked: cn path not on DEV (Issue #18) – owner dev

tcs.summary: EN: Verify PC (1440) and SP (390) layout match Figma C08 with no horizontal overflow. JP: Figma C08 どおり、横スクロールなし。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Capture full page at 1440×900 and 390×844. 2. Record scrollWidth. 3. Compare with Figma C08 (DSR-173 node) via design QA checklist. JP: キャプチャ比較。
tcs.expected: EN: scrollWidth ≤ viewport; no difference in order, spacing > 4 px, fonts, colours; differences listed. JP: 差分なし。

assumptions: Baseline = DSR-587 description + BL-OVL-1 (docs/DSR-587/overlay-data-flow-BL.md, Martin 2026-10-16) + DSR-647. Video overlay done per Martin; branch test host https://dsr-productdetail-moustache--dsr-eds-dev--sutrix-projects.aem.page (comment 61119). Verdict on main .aem.live.

Old QA data qa501-* / qa190-* under /content/dam/ykk/common/product-cf/test/ do NOT generate overlay pages; new data qa587-* is created at target paths (CF commune /content/dam/common/{lang}/movies/{id}, CF related /content/dam/dsr/{lang}/movies/standard/{id}).
[Giả định] Movie list target for isActive=false/unavailable = /{lang}/library/video/search (Martin test URL).
[Giả định] Related order: BL-OVL-1 update (Martin 16/10: update date desc, mixed types) overrides DSR-647 'authored order'. Max 5 + isUnavailable hide apply to related movies.
[Giả định] Tech talk: BL-OVL-1 says 'other subfolder → no page' but DSR-587 TCC#2 requires /video/tech-talk/<id>. TC written to the ticket; blocked until path rule is confirmed (Q32).
Agents are read-only without Author access; seeding and 9.0 are done by QA-PT.
testdata: Main movie: CF commune + CF related, live
movieId / movieTitle / description / movieSource / movieSourceId / thumbnail / relatedProducts · CF related: isActive / movie
qa587-main / QA587 main movie / 'QA587 line1⏎line2' / YouTube / any public YouTube id / any QA image / 1 existing product · isActive ON / movie = commune
qa587-unavail: commune unpublished, CF related republished
CF related qa587-rel-a; commune relatedMovies = qa587-r1 … qa587-r6 (6 communes, published) + 1 article + 1 LP if available
6 movies (edit r1…r6 on different days or record their update dates)
CF related qa587-rel-b; commune relatedMovies = qa587-r1, qa587-off (commune isUnavailable = TRUE)
howto: CF commune: https://author-p192812-e2014374.adobeaemcloud.com/assets.html/content/dam/common/en/movies → Create → Content Fragment → model DM_movie → Name = id (lowercase, digits, hyphen only) → fill TestData values → Save → Publish (live).
Folder missing → note it, skip that TD

CF related: …/assets.html/content/dam/dsr/en/movies/standard → Create → Content Fragment → model dm_movie_related (or DM_movie_dsr) → same Name → isActive ON → movie = CF commune of step 1 → Save → Publish (live). TD-587-02: Preview only.
Model not in list → note names shown, skip

Special: 04 name 'QA587_Upper' (if Author refuses the name, note 'refused' = also Pass input for 4.0); 05 create subfolder qa587 first; 07 isActive OFF then republish; 08 unpublish commune then republish related; 10 publish, wait 10 min, Unpublish; 15 set isUnavailable TRUE on commune qa587-off.
Never rename/move a published CF related
Do NOT reuse qa501-* data (wrong path, A2).
